name: Appartment Kalkus
beschreibung: The Appartment Kalkus is run as an inn in Tirol. The establishment has several guest rooms as well as a restaurant area with regional cuisine. The accommodation is traditionally furnished and places value on hospitality. Guests can book half board here and enjoy the Tiroler Spezialitäten. The location in the federal state of Tirol makes the inn a starting point for excursions into the surrounding mountains.
